verbatim_agent_sentence: We are escalating our involvement to ensure that the ongoing strategic review results in a complete separation of the royalty business from the commercial operating segment.
grader_notes: The agent correctly identified the core thesis of separating royalty assets from operating business, matching the primary driver of the original escalation. It captured the need for oversight and separation, though it added several specific, later-dated tactical drivers (such as the Nuvion failure) that were not part of the original Loeb rationale in the 2007 letter. The reasoning is closest in its focus on asset simplification and farthest in its reliance on specific 2008 clinical failures to justify the historical stance.
